text.polite: Hello there. I'm {officer} with City Police.
text.commanding: Police. I need to talk to you.

text.polite: I'd like to explain why I'm here: {reason}.
text.commanding: Here's why I'm talking to you: {reason}.
text.aggressive: You know why I am here. {reason}.

text.polite: Could I please see some identification?
text.commanding: I need to see your identification.

text.polite: May I ask your name?
text.commanding: State your full name.

text.polite: And your date of birth, please?
text.commanding: Give me your date of birth.

text.polite: What's your current address, please?
text.commanding: Give me your home address.

text.polite: Where are you headed tonight?
text.commanding: Tell me where you're going.
text.aggressive: Where do you think you are going?

text.polite: Where are you coming from this evening?
text.commanding: Tell me where you're coming from.

text.polite: Could you tell me what happened?
text.commanding: Tell me what happened.

text.polite: Have you had anything to drink this evening?
text.commanding: Tell me how much you've had to drink.
text.aggressive: How much have you been drinking?

text.polite: Have you taken any drugs or medication tonight?
text.commanding: Tell me what you've taken.

text.polite: Are you carrying any weapons I should know about?
text.neutral: Do you have any weapons on you?
text.commanding: Tell me if you have any weapons.

text.polite: Is there anything in the vehicle I should know about?
text.commanding: Tell me what's in the vehicle.

text.polite: Is this your vehicle?
text.commanding: Tell me who owns this vehicle.

text.polite: Did you see or hear anything?
text.commanding: Tell me what you saw or heard.
text.aggressive: What did you see? What did you hear?

text.polite: Are you hurt at all? Do you need medical attention?
text.commanding: Tell me if you're injured.

text.polite: Did you happen to see where they went?
text.commanding: Tell me which way they went.

text.polite: Would you mind if I checked your pockets?
text.commanding: I want to search your person. Do you consent?
text.aggressive: Let me search you. Got something to hide?

text.polite: May I take a look inside your vehicle?
text.neutral: Mind if I search your car?
text.commanding: I want to search the vehicle. Do you consent?
text.aggressive: Let me search the car. Got something to hide?

text.polite: Would you be willing to blow into a handheld breath tester?
text.neutral: Will you take a breath test here?
text.commanding: I want you to take a breath test. Do you consent?

text.polite: Would you be willing to do a few balance and coordination exercises?
text.neutral: Will you do some field sobriety tests?
text.commanding: I want you to do field sobriety tests. Do you consent?
text.aggressive: Do the sobriety tests. Or is there a problem?

text.polite: May I come in and talk with you?
text.commanding: I need to come inside. Do you consent?

text.polite: Would you consent to a search of the residence?
text.neutral: Mind if I search the place?
text.commanding: I want to search the premises. Do you consent?
text.aggressive: Let me search the place. Got something to hide?

text.polite: Do you mind if I look around this room?
text.neutral: Mind if I look around in here?
text.commanding: I want to search this room. Do you consent?
text.aggressive: I'm looking around this room. Problem?

text.polite: Could you stop there for a moment, please?
text.commanding: Stop. Stay where you are.

text.polite: Could you raise your hands for me, please?
text.commanding: Hands up! Where I can see them.

text.polite: Please get down on the ground.
text.commanding: Get on the ground. Do it now.
text.aggressive: Get down! Get on the ground!

text.polite: Would you turn around for me, please?
text.commanding: Turn around and face away from me.

text.polite: Could you come over here, please?
text.commanding: Come over here. Slowly.

text.polite: Please stay back, for your safety.
text.commanding: Stay back. Do not approach.

text.polite: Would you follow me, please?
text.commanding: Follow me. Stay close.

text.polite: Please have a seat.
text.commanding: Sit down right there.

text.polite: Would you step out of the vehicle, please?
text.commanding: Step out of the car now.

text.polite: Please put the weapon down.
text.commanding: Drop the weapon! Now!

text.polite: Could I see your hands, please?
text.commanding: Show me your hands! Keep them visible.
text.aggressive: Hands! Let me see your hands, now!

text.polite: I need to ask you to leave the area, please.
text.commanding: You need to leave the area now.
text.aggressive: Get out of here! Leave the area!

text.polite: Folks, please move along.
text.commanding: Disperse. Clear the area.
text.aggressive: Break it up! Clear out, everyone!

text.polite: Let's take a breath and calm down, okay?
text.commanding: Calm down and listen to me.

text.polite: Would you turn off the engine, please?
text.commanding: Turn off the engine and keep your hands visible.

text.polite: Could you toss the keys out the window?
text.commanding: Throw the keys out the window.

text.polite: Could you walk backward toward me, please?
text.commanding: Walk backward to my voice. Slowly.

text.polite: Take a breath, I'm here to help.
text.neutral: It's okay. I'm here to help.
text.commanding: Listen to me. You're safe.
text.aggressive: Relax! I'm not going to hurt you.

text.polite: I am going to read you your rights. Please listen carefully.
text.neutral: I need to advise you of your rights.
text.commanding: Listen carefully. I am advising you of your rights.
text.aggressive: Listen up. These are your rights.

text.polite: You're free to go. Thank you for your cooperation.
text.commanding: You can go.

text.polite: I'm only giving you a warning this time.
text.commanding: This is your warning. Don't let it happen again.

text.polite: Thank you for your cooperation.
text.commanding: That's all I needed.
